'''Bodan Siraam''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Fallout" /> By [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Siraam was a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] for the [[Selkath Isolationists]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="Fallout" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bodan Siraam appears in the Manaan Daily Area introduced in Game Update 7.1: ''Digging Deeper'', released on [[August 2]], [[2022]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Digging Deeper">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220802|text=Game Update 7.1 "Digging Deeper" is live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
